caption: The drawing depicts a long, double-caped overcoat with a front view shown in color and two rear views sketched in outline. The overcoat is primarily tan or light brown in color, with two cape layers draped over the shoulders and upper arms, each with a rounded edge and visible seams. The coat is buttoned down the front with five buttons and features slanted side pockets. The collar is a contrasting red hue, and the inner lining of the cuffs is also red. The two outline sketches to the right illustrate the back of the coat, showing additional seam and button details as well as the structure of the capes and a belt-like strap on the lower back. The paper background is beige and unadorned.
title: Man's Great Coat
